events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) and Adebayo (MIA) come together at the same spot and the ensuing contact is marginal.
VanVleet (HOU) immediately slides his hand off of Herro's (MIA) side and legally contests the jump shot.
Green (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Herro's (MIA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) intentionally kicks the ball.
Highsmith (MIA) briefly places his hand on VanVleet (HOU), but the contact is marginal.
Adebayo (MIA) and Sengun (HOU) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
VanVleet (HOU) does not release the throw-in within five seconds. The five-second count was reached prior to the timeout request by VanVleet.
VanVleet (HOU) is ejected from the game after making contact with a game official.
Thompson (HOU) reaches in and initiates contact with Herro's (MIA) arm which causes him to lose control of the ball.
Green (HOU) has his foot planted on the ground when the ball is dribbled off of his foot.
Sengun (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Thompson (HOU), Coach Udoka (HOU), and Coach Sullivan (HOU) are assessed technical fouls and ejected from the game for the Rockets. Herro (MIA) and Rozier (MIA) are assessed technical fouls and ejected from the game for the Heat.
Holiday (HOU) reaches in and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Jaquez Jr. (MIA).
Holiday (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Holiday (HOU) wraps his arm around Burks' (MIA) waist and affects his FOM. The illegal contact is correctly assessed as an away-from-the-play foul.
Sengun (HOU) briefly places his hands on Jovic's (MIA) body as he makes the pass.
Brooks (HOU) is out of bounds when he reaches in and makes contact with the ball.
Whitmore (HOU) briefly places a hand on Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) side before immediately removing it as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Holiday (HOU) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA).
Smith Jr. (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
